Watch 7650 as an expiry-specific gamma concentration, 7600 as the next large put-gamma strike, 7700 as a major put wall and potential reclaim level, 7711-7773 as the contested near-spot flip zone, and 7900-8000 as higher call-gamma resistance. Rising crude oil prices, geopolitical risk, flash PMIs and consumer sentiment are potential volatility catalysts.
